# ANALYSIS: BASE_ENGINE_J_DAYS_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We validate the base engine's performance on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) using walk-forward OOS and real-fills simulation to confirm edge_capture stability and rule out overfit. The base engine currently shows edge_capture=780 (50% of max 1542) in full-sample backtests; we test if this holds in OOS and realistic fills.

## Mechanism

Walk-forward OOS: expanding window training (2025-01-02 to 2025-12-31) testing on 2026-01-02 to 2026-06-18, measuring edge_capture on J days within the OOS window. Real-fills validation: re-simulate the three J days using cached OPRA bid/ask with slippage model (L23 fix) vs. BS-sim, requiring <±20% P&L deviation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ required for full qty=28 (ITM-2 0DTE puts); $1K paper realizes ~14% headline edge_capture ($109 of $780).
2. **Sample bias:** J days n=3 (3 winners, 3 losers); selection method = immutable source-of-truth per OP-16; overfit risk high due to small sample (winner days may not persist).
3. **Out-of-sample:** Walk-forward OOS edge_capture=$712 (2026-01-02..2026-06-18 window) vs. IS $780 (−9% degradation, still >771 floor? 712<771 → FAILS OOS edge_capture gate).
4. **Real-fills:** Top 3 J days show −10% avg P&L degradation vs. BS-sim (within ±20% tolerance); real-fills edge_capture=$702.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day = 5/04 OOS real-fills −$120 (engine took loser due to VIX spike false signal); max drawdown = −$1,850 (OOS period); blow-up scenario = consecutive VIX mean-reversion days causing 3+ loser-day entries.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days (all J winners) = 198% of OOS P&L (edge_capture driven entirely by 3 winner days; ordinary days NET-LOSE).

## Pre-merge gate

`test_j_walkforward_oos.py` (edge_capture≥771, Sharpe≥0.70) + `test_j_realfills_ab.py` (top 3 J days P&L deviation <±20%) + gym validators 81/81 PASS.

## Confidence

4 / 10 -- OOS edge_capture ($712) falls below 771 floor; real-fills validation shows concentration risk and OOS degradation. Base engine fails OP-16 OOS gate despite passing IS.
